summary: This page illustrates and labels all front panel controls of the Vulcan OmniPro 220 welder, including buttons, knobs, sockets, and connection points.

diagrams.label: Vulcan OmniPro 220 Front Panel Controls Diagram
diagrams.spatial: Top area contains the control panel with LCD display in the center, Home Button and Control Knob on the left, Back Button on the upper right, Left Knob on the lower left of the panel, Right Knob on the lower right of the panel. Middle section shows the VULCAN branding, Power Switch on the left side, MIG Gun/Spool Gun Cable Socket on the lower left, Storage Compartment on the right side, Positive Socket on the lower right. Bottom section contains from left to right: Spool Gun Gas Outlet, Negative Socket, Wire Feed Power Cable, and Positive Socket connections.
callouts: MIG Gun/ Spool Gun Cable Socket

key_facts: The Vulcan OmniPro 220 has a Home Button on the front panel
The Vulcan OmniPro 220 has a Back Button on the front panel
The front panel includes a Control Knob
The front panel includes a Left Knob and a Right Knob
The welder has an LCD Display on the front panel
A Power Switch is located on the front panel
The MIG Gun and Spool Gun share a Cable Socket on the front panel
There is a dedicated Spool Gun Gas Outlet on the front panel
The front panel has both a Negative Socket and a Positive Socket
A Wire Feed Power Cable connection is on the front panel
There is a Storage Compartment on the front panel
An optional Spool Gun is sold separately
When using a Spool Gun, connect the Spool Gun gas hose to the Spool Gun Gas Outlet
This information is on Page 8 of the manual
